[LNUL.8.7] **A nullable `Time` is an ordinary nullable value; the time axis
is never null.** The one slot a construct orders facts by is `ts`, and [LFAC.9.1]
requires it to be a `Time` that is not nullable. `within` and `dwell` read no
slot ([LTIM.2.8.6]). No other slot is a time axis, so the compiler must admit a
`Time?` slot of any other name, and a `null` in it Kleene-propagates
([LNUL.4.1]), as a `null` in a `Date?` or a `Duration?` does.
